name: File Paths - Authorized - External Network Share [starts with]
description: Intent: Authorized external network-share paths — populate with UNC path prefixes of sanctioned partner / vendor file shares (e.g., \\partner-acme.com\shared, \\cloud-share.vendor.com\). Drives the Authorized External direction on D8020 / M8020 and is negated alongside the Internal share list to define the Unauthorized share surface on D8000 / M8000 / W8000 / B8000. Exclusions: do not add contractor-managed shares without vetting; do not add paths to servers lacking access controls or encryption; prefer fully-qualified hostnames to avoid prefix collisions with internal paths.
